name: Unbounded TSDF Mesh Extraction
aliases: Unbounded TSDF Mesh Extraction with Contraction
definition: Extracts meshes from unbounded scenes by contracting space, performing adaptive TSDF fusion in the contracted space, and using marching cubes.
summary: Unbounded TSDF Mesh Extraction extracts triangle meshes from 3D Gaussians by contracting infinite space into a bounded volume, enabling adaptive TSDF fusion without predefined depth limits or massive global grids.
